caption: The drawing depicts a single candleholder with a candle set against a plain background. The candleholder consists of a rectangular metal tray base with raised edges, a vertical rectangular backplate with a rounded top, and a small cylindrical holder in the center of the tray where the candle is placed. The backplate features a zigzag pattern running vertically, bordered by symmetrical flower or asterisk shapes on either side. The top edge of the backplate is scalloped, and there is a round hole in its upper center, possibly for hanging. The overall color of the metal is rendered in muted shades of gray, blue, and hints of purple, suggesting tarnished or patinated metal. The candle is colored in a soft orange tone with a blackened, curving wick at its tip. The artist’s signature and location, “Maggie C. Claflin - Taos - N.M.,” appear in the bottom right corner. The background is left plain and off-white, focusing attention on the candleholder and candle.
title: Tin Sconce
